parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test target directories — 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' (package: Artwork) and 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift' (package: AppServices) — making them test fixtures by file-path evidence even though the pipeline emitted is_test=false. The name 'MockArtworkService' is a canonical mock/test-double identifier. Both records are type-alias-objects with empty fields_or_signature and empty name fields, providing no structural basis for a shared abstraction. Consolidating these across two separate test packages would couple unrelated test suites without benefit.
